event_summary: A tan liquid in a metal pot bubbles continuously while a pale foam patch changes shape, and a utensil enters from above near the end.
raw_event_description: The video shows a cylindrical metal pot containing tan liquid. From the first frame, the liquid surface is covered with many small bubbles and ripples. A pale foam-like patch near the lower center changes outline and position over time. Dark specks remain visible on the inner wall of the pot. Near the end, a broad utensil enters from the upper right, moves downward toward the liquid, and contacts or approaches the right side of the surface.

reasons: The pot and liquid surface are visible from the start.
The bubbling process is already underway in the first frame.
The lower outside of the pot and surrounding stove area are only partly visible.
